facts.text: Snow left Ostrander Lake (8,200 ft) 20 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Ostrander Lake
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: June 24 (2023), May 28 (2024), May 17 (2025)

facts.text: At Ostrander Lake (8,200 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 11.0 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Ostrander Lake
evidence.detail: 11.0 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 91.3 in (2023), 41.3 in (2024), 33.9 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 4 and May 9, carried from the melt-out dates at Poison Ridge (6,900 ft) and Chilkoot Meadow (7,120 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Poison Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out April 29, 1,368 ft above the pass; points to March 4 to May 7

evidence.name: Chilkoot Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out May 4, 1,588 ft above the pass; points to March 4 to May 10
